title: Small Business Weekend
seo_title: Small Business Weekend in Springfield, MO – Nov 27-28
description: Small Business Weekend is a two-day holiday shopping event hosted by Finding You Treasures, where booths offer 10%, 25% or 50% off, with a few at 75% off. Festive music will be playing as you shop. It runs Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM at 1027 S Glenstone Ave in Springfield, MO.
